falsification.countingRule: Material contract mutants are executed and killed once per family; the 10M count is deterministic symbolic mutation-schedule coverage over those families, not 10M executed browser or contract clones.
falsification.claimBoundary: Deterministic semantic/design-contract evidence is repository E2 falsification, not ten million browser sessions, users, accessibility studies or proof of aesthetic quality.

humanEvidenceBoundary: Pleasantness, comprehension, task efficiency and assistive-technology usability remain E3-HUMAN.
